note: Alberta Parks campground on Ross Lake in Whitney Lakes Provincial Park, east of Elk Point: well-treed sites in six loops near natural sand beaches, with a boat launch, pier, fish-cleaning station, cook shelter, playground and more than 30 km of trails. Since July 3, 2026 the lakeside hiking trail between Loops B and D has been closed by flooding. --Claude
